items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: No, me and Remus played together with John Cassidy.

ctx.x: Yeah, play like, one place he'd play all the summer, one place he'd play all the winter. For Trent Sheeners and all them people like that you know. You wanna come in? Come on.
Oh yeah. Hey boys. I was gonna ask you, did you ever play with the Matthews brothers, Bebe or Remus very much? You mentioned Bebe.
No, me and Remus played together with John Cassidy.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Yeah, I played, I played in Allen's band... Remus Matthews, you know, was playing drums.

ctx.x: Did you ever play in the Allen brass band?

Yeah, I played, I played in Allen's band. Then after that I played, I could have played twice in that band. Two Conval Street I played, one of the old band there. He was playing parades over here on Conval. So that Conval he wanted me to play, and I mean this boy, Tom Albert boy, he said, Albert. So he wanted us to play a parade with him. Remus Matthews, you know, was playing drums. So I told him, I said, this boy told me that the job was playing $25, you know what I mean? I said, I said, Lucia, we call him…
